phasing_details.phase_detail: Erection of a rear extension, conversion of the first and second floors into a 3-bedroom flat and rear fenestration alteration.

description: Conversion of the first and second floors into a 3-bedroom flat and retention of the ground floor as an E-Class unit. Proposed door at rear elevation to form an entrance for the proposed flat, rear extension at the second floor level and removal of the redundant chimneys.
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-7f19ad66-7fff-5558-6577-7cb7a5c394c0"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:10pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed residential unit fails to provide an acceptable standard of accommodation due to inadequate sanitary provision for a three-bedroom dwelling and the absence of any private outdoor amenity space, contrary to Policy D6 of the London Plan and Policies LP1, LP2 and LP17 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and the NPPF 2024.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-77efe36a-7fff-7100-148e-b7741e63848c"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:10pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposal would result in the unjustified loss of Class E employment floorspace within a Major Town Centre. Insufficient and incomplete marketing evidence has been submitted to demonstrate a lack of demand for the existing office use or to justify its loss, contrary to Policy LP28 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033, the London Plan and the NPPF 2024.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-75459086-7fff-c036-9a0d-00bca6d7f523"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:10pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed extension would result in an unacceptable level of internal amenity. The development is therefore contrary to Policy LP2 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and Policy D6 of the London Plan and the NPPF 2024.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-96ecf169-7fff-ba53-00e5-dd7ddb962ba5"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:10pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">No legal agreement has been submitted to secure the development as car-free contrary to Policies LP41, LP42, LP43 and LP45 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and the London Plan and the NPPF 2024.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-caa68b11-7fff-6896-fb17-feea9294f1f9"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:10pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">Insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate that energy demand and carbon emissions would be minimised in accordance with the London Plan energy hierarchy. As such, the proposal is contrary to Policies LP54 and LP55 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and the NPPF 2024.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-05ff449f-7fff-30c0-1836-3beaf6f47e0e"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed development would have a detrimental impact upon the character and appearance of the host property whilst failing to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area. No public benefits have been identified that would outweigh the level of harm caused </span><span style="font-size: 14px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">contrary to Policies D1, D3, D4 and HC1 of the London Plan and Policies LP1 and LP3 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and the NPPF 2024.</span></p>
